--- a/examples/apps/quorum/src/contract/RoleMachine.decide.contract
+++ b/examples/apps/quorum/src/contract/RoleMachine.decide.contract
@@ -30,7 +30,7 @@
 decide(CANDIDATE, Response[term=CURRENT])       => Unchanged[reason="a reply from the current or an older term changes no role"]
 decide(CANDIDATE, Response[term=NEWER])         => Transition[next=FOLLOWER, effects=[ADOPT_TERM]]
 decide(CANDIDATE, null)                         => throws NullPointerException
-decide(LEADER, ElectionTimeout[])               => Unchanged[reason="a leader does not hold elections"]
+decide(LEADER, ElectionTimeout[])               => Transition[next=CANDIDATE, effects=[INCREMENT_TERM, VOTE_FOR_SELF, REQUEST_VOTES]]

 decide(LEADER, VotesCounted[majority=true])     => Unchanged[reason="votes of an election this server is no longer in"]
 decide(LEADER, AppendEntries[term=OLDER])       => Rejected[reason="stale leader"]
@@ -43,7 +43,7 @@
 decide(LEADER, Response[term=CURRENT])          => Unchanged[reason="a reply from the current or an older term changes no role"]
 decide(LEADER, Response[term=NEWER])            => Transition[next=FOLLOWER, effects=[ADOPT_TERM]]
 decide(LEADER, null)                            => throws NullPointerException
-decide(null, ElectionTimeout[])                 => throws NullPointerException
+decide(null, ElectionTimeout[])                 => Transition[next=CANDIDATE, effects=[INCREMENT_TERM, VOTE_FOR_SELF, REQUEST_VOTES]]
 decide(null, VotesCounted[majority=false])      => throws NullPointerException

 decide(null, AppendEntries[term=OLDER])         => Rejected[reason="stale leader"]
